mask_rules.hair: largest index-9 hair anchor plus nearby index-8/9 gray locks and 5-of-8 interior support inside a local head halo
mask_rules.coat_skin_leather: source palette seed masks plus unambiguous 5-of-8 same-material interior support; no expansion over outline, transparency, or protected accent zones
mask_rules.white_accessory: compact glove clusters, collar pixels attached to the cravat anchor, and long straight white/gray cane-shaft components
mask_rules.burgundy_allowed: central upper-torso cravat component and burgundy components touching leather near the boot baseline
mask_rules.yellow_allowed: yellow components anchored to the cane shaft/pommel and owner-authorized brass glasses near the face
mask_rules.yellow_pending: empty under the owner-approved v08.1 glasses policy
mask_rules.cane_shaft: white 1px centerline; the original dark outline is preserved, and internal gray/white striping is forbidden
mask_rules.cluster_cleanup: sub-2x2 components in hair, coat, and skin shading ramps are reassigned to a neighboring legal tone inside their own mask
